brief: A seed-starting tray of at least four cells, each with a draining bin.

requirements.evidence: 4 hexagonal cells at (0,0), (1,0), (0,1), (0,-1) joined and capped

requirements.requirement: each cell with a draining bin
requirements.evidence: bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full-drain, bin:1,0,0~hex-bin-full-drain, bin:0,1,0~hex-bin-full-drain, bin:0,-1,0~hex-bin-full-drain – all drained variants, filled with soil and planted as seed-starting tray

finish.summary: Built a 4-cell hexagonal tray, each cell fitted with a full-depth drained bin (hex-bin-full-drain), filled with soil and seedlings to demonstrate seed-starting use. Joints locked and open faces capped.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
